item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Highs today range from fifty-three to fifty-five degrees with mostly sunny skies, and tonight's lows fall between thirty-five and thirty-nine degrees under partly cloudy to mostly cloudy conditions. Skies remain mostly clear early this morning, and no precipitation is expected through tonight. The entire region stays dry with only a slight chance of a stray sprinkle, but measurable rain is not in the forecast.
